newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Tuan Sing to issue S$78 million FRNs.
newsitem.headline: Tuan Sing to issue S$78 million FRNs.

text.p: The Tuan Sing Group said on Monday it had entered into subscription agreements for the issue of Singapore $38 million in secured floating rate notes (FRNs) and S$40 million in guaranteed floating rate notes.
Tuan Sing said in a statement that the FRNs would be due in the year 2000 and issued through wholly-owned subsidiary Golden Cape Investments Ltd.
The net proceeds would be used to re-finance the acquisition of two sites at Leedon Park and finance the development of six good-class bungalows on the combined sites.

The notes are in bearer form, with interest coupons attached, in denomination of S$250,000 each. Interest will be paid quarterly in arrears, at rates to be decided between Golden Cape and Schroder International Merchant Bankers, the arranger and lead manager of the issues. -- Singapore newsroom 65-8703080
